name: timmy-ui
status: source authored (R11 round 7, H174); the compiled timmy-ui.riv beside this file is the version named in `asset` — v1 until the v2 build lands

asset.built: the Rive CLI on the operator's machine (`rive . --verify`, `rive . --once`), from scene.rml as create-controls.py writes it; VERIFY.txt and BUILD.txt beside it record the run

font.licence: Outfit-OFL.txt (SIL OFL 1.1; no Reserved Font Name declared)
font.made_by: make-font.py from @fontsource-variable/outfit's latin woff2 — the font this product serves at /web/fonts/

served.listing: GET /api/rive/assets (runtime, components, mark; the companion and the Studio)

State.note: no success value: a connected provider is State 0 and the words say connected

Hover.note: the page's selection (tldraw) or the pointer over an ActionButton; never a state

Pressed.note: a press, down then up on the next frame; never a state

ReducedMotion.note: zero-duration transitions AND the Working pose without its spinning ring (the WorkingStill state): nothing keeps moving; the words carry the state

runs.Title: TIMMY  /  AGENT CONSOLE
runs.Tag: NATIVE RIVE UI → the page sets the turn's identity words
runs.Caption: '' → the page sets LIVE  /  THE TURN’S EVENTS
runs.HeadlineIdle…HeadlineFailed: the authored headline per state (baked in its state group)

runs.Title: TIMMY  /  PROVIDERS
runs.Tag: NATIVE RIVE UI → the page's words

ActionButtonGlacier.role: the same button in the Glacier material (a mount picks by the page's data-theme)

Caption = PREVIEW  /  NOT A LIVE JOB

materials.registry: DESIGN.md B11 / the study's token registry v0.1
materials.focus: #FFB000 (the Working ring, Approval, Failed: focus / intent / attention)
materials.neverOnAFace: #28FE14 — no observed-live claim is drawn; the HTML words say connected / passed / sealed

consumers.mountApi: window.TimmyRive.mountConsole(host, { size, label, heading, name, place, identity: { project, session }, caption }) · mountProviderCard(host, providerId, { size, label, name, place, providerName, detail }) · mountActionButton(host, { label, action, disabled, name, place, theme })
consumers.handle: root, unmount(), setLabel(words) (writes Caption), setDisabled(bool), setProvider({ name, detail }) on a card, place
consumers.feeds: fromSse(event, data, source) · fromProviderState(id, word, source) · stopping(source) · reconcile(word, { turn, source })
consumers.identity: a 'turn' event names the feed's current turn (data.id); 'needs-you' / 'done' of another turn are ignored as stale (recorded, never applied); 'done'.receipt is attached to the handle; stopping = STOP REQUESTED until 'done' cancelled
consumers.shape: timmy-rive props { w, h, component, state, label, provider } unchanged; AS SAVED / NOT A LIVE JOB until a feed event reaches it on its page
consumers.versions: the bindings tell v1 from v2 by the runs present (v2: Caption on every production artboard); v1's runtime workarounds (the caption overwrite, the scaled pill) apply to a v1 file only
